title: Relationship Relativity When a Named Driver Exclusion Is Lifted (Owner Auto Policy Filed Driver Rating Q&A)
content:
**Rule.** Under the company's filed driver rating, a relationship relativity multiplies the lift share of a driver whose named driver exclusion is lifted on the Owner Auto Policy. The share is multiplied before it is rounded to the cent. The relationship is the one recorded on the driver's exclusion entry, the most recent driver-excluded entry on the term.

| Relationship on the exclusion entry | Relativity |
|---|---|
| child, sibling, parent or other relative | 1.05 |
| unrelated household member | 1.2 |
| spouse, or any other relationship | 1 |
| no such entry on the term | 1 |

**Questions the rule answers.**
- *A parent of the named insured whose exclusion is lifted?* 1.05.
- *A spouse?* 1.
- *Hypothetically, a lift share of 250.00 before this relativity, for an unrelated household member?* 300.00 before rounding.
